page_note: Page contains the close of one kephalaion (the four-fathers/revealers teaching) and the opening of a new one (Teaching of the Lions). The first ~21 segments continue an extended cosmological correspondence: the tongue inside the body that proclaims/reveals concerning the body is paralleled with Jesus/the Radiance, sent forth from the Greatness, who reveals concerning the aeons, the ships of Light, and the living soul. This is substratic cosmological correspondence even though Jesus is named — Jesus the Splendor functions here as a cosmic revealer-figure paired with the inner tongue. The closing 'Behold, I have made known to you forth' (seg 18-20) is hortatory closure. Segments 22-24 are the new chapter title and topic question. Segments 25-33 begin a hagiographic narrative frame about Mani before Sapores the King at the flooded Tigris with the lions — pure apostolic_dialogue framing material with editorial seam flagged at seg 25. Strong second-half editorial drift confirmed by the fatigue score (cosmological→apostolic shift).
